title: Re-Enforced: Metals
description: Overhauling progression with 3 new metal tiers
body:
![Re-Enforced: Metals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/15ebbd0133d14d085804c2c0805cdb2bbeace1ac_0.webp)
Re-Enforced introduces 3 new progression tiers, Steel, Rose gold and platinum. Upgrade your playthrough experience with an upgrades progression loop. This mod is the sister mod to the Arsenal: Weaponry mod, adding a range of new items for every progression tier.


![Re-Enforced: Items](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/b3152ba9151dff5e3d734247d83de89f39985759_0.webp)

- Steel armor 
- Steel tools
- Copper armor
- Copper tools
- Platinum amor
- Platinum tools
- Rose gold armor
- Rose gold tools

![Re-Enforced X Arsenal: weaponry](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/2a49d1fcf30c70042ce3a22596828b733ccb3af6_0.webp)
Each metal tier gains an additional 11 new weapons, adding 33 new metal weapons to your game.
